episodeTitle.en: The paths to power: How to grow your influence and advance your career | Jeffrey Pfeffer (Stanford)
episodeTitle.zh: 通往权力的道路：如何提升你的影响力并推进你的职业生涯 | 杰弗里·普费弗（Jeffrey Pfeffer，斯坦福大学）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jeffrey Pfeffer teaches the single most popular (and somewhat controversial) class at Stanford’s Graduate School of Business: The Paths to Power. He’s also the author of 16 books, including 7 Rules of Power: Surprising—But True—Advice on How to Get Things Done and Advance Your Career. He has taught at Harvard, the London Business School, and IESE and has written for publications like Fortune and the Washington Post. Recognized by the Academy of Management and listed in the Thinkers50 Hall of Fame, Jeffrey also serves on several corporate and nonprofit boards, bringing his expertise to global audiences through seminars and executive education. In our conversation, we discuss: • Jeffrey’s seven rules of power
guestBioOfficial.zh:
杰弗里·普费弗（Jeffrey Pfeffer）在斯坦福商学院的研究生院教授最受欢迎（但颇具争议）的课程《通往权力的道路》。他还是16本书的作者，包括《权力的七条法则：令人惊讶却真实的建议》和《提升职业生涯》。他曾在哈佛大学、伦敦商学院和IESE商学院任教，并为《财富》杂志和《华盛顿邮报》等媒体撰稿。杰弗里获得了管理学会的认可，并入选Thinkers50名人堂，同时还担任多家企业和非营利组织的董事会成员，通过研讨会和高管教育向全球受众传播专业知识。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：
• 杰弗里提出的七条权力法则

title.en: The paths to power: How to grow your influence and advance your career | Jeffrey Pfeffer (Stanford)
title.zh: 通往权力的道路：如何提升你的影响力并推进你的职业生涯 | 杰弗里·普费弗（Jeffrey Pfeffer，斯坦福大学）

summary.en: Jeffrey lays out his seven rules of power—get out of your own way, break the rules, show up powerfully, build a brand, network relentlessly, use your power, and accept that how you got it will be forgiven—and insists these are masterable skills, not personality. He argues that if you think power is 'dirty' you'll unconsciously sabotage your own success, and that more good people need power so it's used for good. The conversation walks through each rule with real examples and ends with concrete steps you can start today to build your own power, whether you're an IC or a CEO.
summary.zh: Jeffrey 列出了他的七条权力法则——别挡自己的路、打破规则、以强者的姿态出现、建立个人品牌、不懈地经营人脉、运用你的权力、并接受一个事实：你获取权力的方式终会被原谅——并强调这些都是可掌握的技能，而非性格。他主张，如果你认为权力“肮脏”，就会在潜意识里 sabotage 自己的成功；而需要更多好人掌握权力，权力才能被用于善。对话逐条讲解每条法则并配以真实案例，最后给出你今天就能开始的、建立自身权力的具体步骤——无论你是个人贡献者还是 CEO。
